「――――翡、翠」
「志貴さま、ご気分が優れないのですか？」
「いや―――そういう、わけじゃなくて」
　……ただ、ひどく懐かしい夢を見た。
　でも内容が思い出せない。
「なんだっけ……よく、思い出せない」
「？」
　翡翠はかすかに首をかしげる。
　……そうか、翡翠に言っても仕方がないよな。
　今のは―――どんな、夢だったんだろう。
　目が潰れるぐらいの眩しい白と、激しく流れ出した赤色のまだら。
lines.label: s235
lines.maoEnglish:
“Hi――――sui.”
“Master Shiki, are you feeling unwell?”
“No―――it isn’t that.”
I had simply dreamed of something achingly familiar.
But I could no longer remember what it was.
“What was it—I can’t quite remember.”
“?”
Hisui tilted her head a fraction.
Of course—there was no point asking her.
What kind of dream had that been―――?
A white so bright it could blind me, slashed by red spreading in violent stains.

“Very well. Excuse me.”

I clutched the sheets and somehow endured it.
“Hah―――ah.”
It passed.
Apparently it had only been a sudden attack; nothing seemed physically wrong.
“The scar on my chest…”
I touched it through my clothes.
A large scar lay there, and though the wound had healed completely, it still hurt like this from time to time.
According to the doctor, pain in the mind could make an old injury hurt again even after the body had healed.

Images of blood and death must call up the accident from eight years ago.

A red alley.
Yumizuka’s smile as she spoke to me there as casually as ever.

My chest hurt.
I couldn’t get Yumizuka out of my head.
But I had no idea what to do—or even what I ought to do.
All I could manage was to go through the motions of Shiki Tohno’s ordinary day.
“Damn―――”
Cursing myself, I got out of bed.
I changed from my pajamas into my school uniform and headed for the sitting room.

Kohaku was probably in the kitchen preparing my breakfast.

“Morning. Sorry about yesterday.”
I returned the greeting and started toward the dining room.
There was no time to sit and talk with Akiha―――and I myself was in no state to talk to anyone.

“Brother, I need to speak with you―――do you have a moment?”
“All right, but I’m short on time, so make it quick.”
I sat on the sofa opposite her.

Akiha questioned me with an unwavering gaze.
“Nothing. I was only walking around town. I’m sorry I came home late, but it’s hardly a catastrophe.”
I didn’t want to lie to her, so I made my answer as vague as possible.

There was no one around.
A dark, lonely place for a meeting.
And there―――someone was crouching on the ground.
Her breath came in harsh gasps.
Her face was deathly pale, and she clawed at her throat in agony.
There was no mistaking Satsuki Yumizuka.

　そんな俺の行動を、弓塚は声だけで止めてしまった。

“Something so―――so horrible!”
“Yesterday was exactly what it looked like. I told you I killed those people, remember?”
She answered without hesitation.
As if mocking my desperate wish to deny it.

lines.label: s236
lines.maoEnglish:
“Are you saying the murders in the city were your doing?”
“I’d rather not answer. But yes, I guess that’s what it means.”
“―――What do you mean by ‘that’s what it means’—why?!”
“It means what it means. I killed those people, and I’m sure I’ll keep doing the same thing. There’s no point lying about it, is there?”
“Yumizuka, you―――”
“Could you stop calling me that? I call you Shiki, so it’s only fair that you call me by my first name too.”

“Looking back, I was such an idiot.

“What――――Yumizuka?”

I’m actually a coward. I forced myself to smile and agree with everyone so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of celebrity.”

But that changed, after you talked to me in the second year of junior high, Shiki-kun."
"Eh--?"
"Nah.
It's not something you'd remember.
How can I put it… You were always natural, never showing off.
Probably you didn't even think about what you said back then."

lines.japanese:
「――――――――」
　なんていえばいいんだろう。
　弓塚の言うとおり、俺は何も覚えていない。
　弓塚と何を話したのか、いや、弓塚と話したことがあるなんていうことさえ、覚えてない。
lines.label: s236
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――――”
What could I say?
She was right—I remembered nothing.
Not what we had talked about—I didn’t even remember ever speaking to her.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"------"
What can I say.
Just as Yumizuka says, I remember nothing.
I don't know what I said to her, or even if I had talked to her back then.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「いいよ、そんな顔しなくても。
志貴くんはあの頃から乾くんに付きっきりだったから、他のクラスメイトには興味がなさそうだったし」
「けど、それでも良かったんだ。
志貴くんと同じ教室にいるんだって思うだけで、すごく嬉しかった。
　いつかあなたにちゃんと話しかけて、弓塚さんって呼ばれることを目標にしてたなんて、今思うとすごく損してたなって笑っちゃうけど」
　懐かしむように彼女は言った。
　とても昔。
……とても遠い昔のことを思い出すように。
lines.label: s236
lines.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right, don’t look like that. You were always off with Arihiko back then, so you never seemed interested in anyone else in class.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy. I dreamed of finally speaking to you properly and hearing you call me by name; looking back, I can’t help laughing at how much time I wasted.”
She spoke with aching nostalgia.
As though remembering something ancient. Something impossibly far away.
lines.mao_english:
“It’s all right, don’t look like that. You were always off with Arihiko back then, so you never seemed interested in anyone else in class.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy. I dreamed of finally speaking to you properly and hearing you call me by name; looking back, I can’t help laughing at how much time I wasted.”
She spoke with aching nostalgia.
As though remembering something ancient. Something impossibly far away.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"It's okay.
Don't make a face like that.
You were only hanging out with Inui-kun, so it was normal for you to ignore other classmates."
"But that was okay.
I was happy just being in the same class as you, Shiki-kun.
It was my goal to talk to you and let you call me Yumizuka-san.
Now that I think about it, it was too small of a wish."
She recalls nostalgically.
Those ancient days.
…… Like she is remembering something that happened a long time ago.

“I watched you all that time. I knew you’d never notice, but I still kept watching.”
“――――――”
To be honest, it made me happy. But―――
“Tell me, Shiki. Do you like me?”
What answer could I possibly give the girl standing before me now―――?

日が沈む。
　街中を走りまわっても、弓塚さつきの姿は見つけられなかった。
「…………くっ」
　悔しくて歯を噛んだ。
　……弓塚が見つからないのが悔しいんじゃない。
lines.label: s237
lines.maoEnglish:
The sun went down.
Though I had run all over the city, I found no trace of Satsuki Yumizuka.
“Damn…”
I clenched my teeth in frustration.
But I wasn’t frustrated because I couldn’t find Yumizuka.

lines.japanese:
二日前。
　この道で、あんな約束をした自分が、腹だたしい。
―――ピンチの時は助けてね。
　そう言ってきた弓塚に、俺は気軽に返答した。
　自分に出来ることなら手を貸すよ、と。
　……それは、なんて無責任な返答だったんだろう。
　俺にできることなんて、本当にちっぽけだ。
　痛い、と。
　痛くて暗くて寒い、なんて苦しんでいた弓塚の姿を見つけ出すことさえ、できない。
lines.label: s237
lines.maoEnglish:
Two days ago.
I was furious with myself for making her that promise on this very road.
―――If I’m ever in trouble, you’ll help me, right?
I had answered Yumizuka so casually.
I told her I would help if there was anything I could do.
What an irresponsible answer that had been.
What I could do was pitifully little.
It hurt, she had said.
Yumizuka had been suffering in pain, in darkness and cold—and I couldn’t even find her.

I should return to the mansion for now and think things through with a clear head.

lines.maoEnglish:
How long had it been?
I had raced through back alleys and deserted streets, but found no sign of Yumizuka.
“Hah―――hah――――hah.”
I stopped to catch my breath and let my overheated body cool.
It was almost midnight.
Searching any longer might be pointless.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
…… How long has it been?
There's no sign of Yumizuka; not in the back alleys nor in the crowds.
*pant*---*pant*----*pant*
I rest my body, burning from all the running.
It's almost midnight.
…… It might be useless to keep looking around.

evidence.japanese:
……どのくらい時間が経っただろう。
　路地裏や人気のないところを走りまわっても、弓塚の姿は見つけられなかった。
「はあ―――はあ――――はあ」
　走りどおしで熱くなった体を休める。
　時間はじき午前零時にさしかかろうとしている。
　……これ以上は、捜しても無駄かもしれない。

lines.japanese:
「どこ行っちまったんだ、あいつ―――」
　立ち止まりかけている足を動かす。
　まだ行っていない場所がある。
　諦めるのは、本当に体が動かなくなったあとにしよう―――
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“Where the hell did she go―――?”
I forced my faltering legs onward.
There were still places I hadn’t checked.
I could give up when my body truly refused to move―――
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Where has she gone…?"
I start walking again.
There's one place I haven't looked yet.
I'll give up after my body really can't move anymore--

lines.japanese:
……華やかな大通りを離れて、公園のほうにやってきた。
　連日の殺人事件でこのあたりには人影がない。
「……………」
　弓塚がいるとは思えないけど、もうここ以外、行っていない場所はなかった。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
I left the brightly lit main street and headed toward the park.
The recent murders had emptied the whole area.
“……”
I doubted Yumizuka would be here, but it was the only place left.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
…… Leaving the brightly-lit main street behind, I arrive at the park.
Because of the serial killings recently, there's not a soul to be seen around here.
"…………"
Even though I can't imagine Yumizuka being here, it's the only place left to look.

lines.japanese:
「―――――」
　夜の公園に人気はない。
　物音一つしない月下。
　わけもなく、全身の体温が下がった気がした。
「―――つ」
　首の後ろがしびれる。
　体がシン……と冷えきって、指先さえかじかんでいくような、悪寒。
「はっ……はっ……」
　冷めていく体とは正反対に、喉が熱かった。
　カラカラに渇いている。
　ポケットの中に手をいれる。
　ただしきりに―――刃物を、手にしていたかった。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
No one else was in the park.
Nothing stirred beneath the moon.
For no reason I could name, the warmth drained from my body.
“―――Ngh.”
The back of my neck tingled.
A chill stole through me until my whole body fell deathly cold and even my fingertips began to numb.
“Hah, hah…”
While my body grew colder, my throat burned.
It was parched dry.
I slipped a hand into my pocket.
More than anything, I wanted a blade in my hand―――!

lines.mirrorMoon:
"-----"
The park is empty at night.
There isn't a sound under the moonlight.
I don't know why, but a chill runs through me.
"--Sst."
The back of my head numbs.
A horrible chill, as if my body freezes to my fingertips.
I try to catch my breath.
In contrast to my cold body, my throat is scorching.
It's dry with thirst.
I put my hand in my pocket.
I just---wanted a blade in my hand.

lines.japanese:
「なん―――だ」
　ギリ………。
　微かな頭痛。
　低くなる体温。
　氷のように冷めていく理性。
　なにか、ヘンだ。
　この公園。
このあたりには、よくないモノが、渦巻いている気がする。
「……まだ奥があったよな、この公園」
　頭痛を振り払って、奥へと足を進ませた。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“What―――is this?”
My teeth ground together.
A faint headache.
My temperature falling.
My reason cooling into ice.
Something was wrong.
This park. Something evil was churning all around it.
“There was more to the park back there, wasn’t there?”
I shook off the headache and pressed deeper inside.
lines.mao_english:

My reason cooling into ice.
Something was wrong.

I shook off the headache and pressed deeper inside.
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Why…?"
Just…
A faint headache.
A low temperature.
My mind is cool like ice.
Something is strange.
This park, it feels like something bad is around here.
"…… A little more till I reach the center of this park."
I shake the headache off, and walk deeper in.

lines.japanese:
あたりには誰もいない。
　ひどく暗くて、寂しい待ち合わせ場所。
　そこに―――誰かが蹲っていた。
　はあはあという呼吸。
　顔色は真っ青で、苦しそうに喉をかきむしっている姿。
　それは間違いなく、弓塚さつきの姿だった。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
No one was there.
Only a lonely meeting place drowned in darkness.
And there―――someone was crouching on the ground.
Ragged breaths.
Their face was deathly pale, and they clawed at their throat in agony.
It was unmistakably Satsuki Yumizuka.

lines.mirrorMoon:
There's no one around.
A terribly dark and lonely place to meet someone.
There--someone is crouched.
Breathing raggedly.
Her face, pale white, as she scratches her throat in pain.
Without a doubt, it is Yumizuka Satsuki.

lines.japanese:
「弓塚―――！？」
　やっと会えたっていう喜びもあったんだろう。
　昨夜のことなんて考えもせず、俺は弓塚へと駆け出した。
「待って―――！」
　そんな俺の行動を、弓塚は声だけで止めてしまった。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumizuka―――!?”
Perhaps I was simply that relieved to have found her.
Without a thought for what had happened the night before, I ran toward her.
“Wait―――!”
Her voice alone stopped me in my tracks.
lines.mao_english:

“Wait―――!”

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yumizuka--!?"
I guess there is the joy of finally finding her.
Not thinking about last night, I run towards her.
"Wait…!"
Yumizuka stops me with just a word.
lines.mirror_moon:

lines.japanese:
「……待ってよ、志貴くん。
志貴くんのほうから来てくれたのは嬉しいけど、今は近くにこられると困っちゃうんだ。
お願いだから、それ以上は近寄らないで」
　苦しげな呼吸で。
　今にも倒れそうに体を震わせながら、弓塚はそんなことを言ってくる。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“Please wait, Shiki… I’m happy you came looking for me, but I can’t have you near me right now. Please—don’t come any closer.”
Every breath was agony.
Her body trembled as though it might collapse, yet still Yumizuka told me to stay away.

lines.japanese:
「ばか、そんな顔色をしてるヤツを放っておけるわけがないだろ……！」
「ううん、わたしは、大丈夫……志貴くんが来てくれたから、もう元気になっちゃった」
　無理やりに体を起こして、弓塚は笑顔をうかべた。
　それは、どうみたって空元気だ。
　……近づけない。
　そうまでして、弓塚は俺を近づけまいとしているんだって、分かってしまったから。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“Don’t be stupid; you look half dead—how am I supposed to leave you like this…?”
“No, I’m all right—now that you’re here, Shiki, I feel better already.”
Yumizuka forced herself upright and smiled.
Her cheer was obviously forced.
I couldn’t bring myself to go closer.
I understood now that she was pushing herself this hard precisely to keep me away.

「……いったいどうしたんだよ弓塚。
どうして家に帰ってないんだ。
昨日のアレは一体なんだったんだ。
どうして、あんな――――」
「ん？
　あんな、なに？」
「……くそ、俺にはわからない！
　ほんとうに――悔しいぐらいわからないんだ、弓塚……！」
「そうなの？
　昨日のことは見たまんまよ。
わたしがあの人たちを殺したって言ったでしょ？」
　あっさりと返答する。
　……それだけは否定したいっていう俺の気持ちを、嘲笑うみたいに。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“What happened to you, Yumizuka? Why haven’t you gone home? What was all that yesterday? Why did you do something so――――”
“Hmm? Something so what?”
“Damn it, I don’t understand! I truly don’t――it’s driving me crazy how little I understand, Yumizuka…!”
“You don’t understand? Yesterday was exactly what it looked like. I told you I killed those people, remember?”
She answered without hesitation.
As though mocking how desperately I wanted that one fact to be false.

lines.maoEnglish:
“Then you’re the one behind the murders in the city?”
“I don’t really want to answer, but yes. I suppose I am.”
“Then why would that be the case?”
“It means what it means. I killed those people, and I’m sure I’ll keep doing the same thing. There’s no point lying about it, is there?”

"I don't like to say it, but… that's the way it is, yeah."
"What the hell do you mean, 'That's the way it is' …!?"
"It's just the way it is.
I killed those people, and I'll keep on doing the same thing.
I can't just lie about it, can I?"

「弓……塚、おまえ―――」
「その呼び方、やめてくれないかな。
わたしだって志貴くんって呼んでるんだから、志貴くんも名前で呼んでくれないと不公平だよ」
「なっ――――」
　ごくりと息を飲む。
　弓塚はやっぱり以前のままだ。
　以前のままの仕草で―――ひどく恐ろしいことを、口にする。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumi―――zuka, you—”
“Would you stop calling me that? I call you Shiki, so it’s only fair that you call me Satsuki.”
“Wh――――”
I swallowed hard.
Yumizuka was still exactly as she had always been.
With all the same gestures as before―――she said something utterly horrifying.

"Please.

"Wha…"
I take a deep breath.
Yumizuka is still like before.

lines.japanese:
「考えてみると、わたしってばかみたいだよね。
こんなふうに志貴くんって呼ぶこともできないで、何年間もあなたのことを遠くから見てるだけだった」
「弓―――塚？」
「ずっと志貴くんのことを見てた。
あの倉庫で助けられる前から、ずっと志貴くんの事を見てた。
　わたし、本当は臆病なんだ。
だから周りの人たちに合わせて、無理をして笑ったり話を合わせたりしてたらね、いつのまにかアイドルみたいに扱われちゃった」
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, I was such an idiot. For years I only watched you from afar, unable even to call you Shiki the way I do now.”
“Yumi―――zuka?”
“I was always watching you. Even before you rescued me from that warehouse, I had been watching you all along.
The truth is, I’m a coward. I kept forcing myself to smile and agree with everyone around me so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of idol.”

lines.japanese:
「だから、学校はあんまり楽しくなかったんだ。
でも中学二年生になったばかりの時にね、志貴くんに話しかけられてから変わったんだ」
「え―――？」
「ううん、志貴くんは覚えてなんかないよ。
なんていうのかな、あなたはいつも自然で、飾らない人だから。
たぶんあの時の言葉も、志貴くんにとってなんでもない一言だったんだろうなあ」
「――――――」
　なんていえばいいんだろう。
　弓塚の言うとおり、俺は何も覚えていない。
　弓塚と何を話したのか、いや、弓塚と話したことがあるなんていうことさえ、覚えてない。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“That was why I never enjoyed school much. But then, just after we started our second year of middle school, you spoke to me, and everything changed.”
“Huh―――?”
“No, you don’t remember. You’ve always been so natural, so completely yourself. Whatever you said that day was probably nothing at all to you.”
“――――――”
What could I possibly say?
She was right.
I remembered nothing—neither what we had spoken about nor even the fact that I had ever spoken to her.

lines.japanese:
「いいよ、そんな顔しなくても。
志貴くんはあの頃から乾くんに付きっきりだったから、他のクラスメイトには興味がなさそうだったし」
「けど、それでも良かったんだ。
志貴くんと同じ教室にいるんだって思うだけで、すごく嬉しかった。
　いつかあなたにちゃんと話しかけて、弓塚さんって呼ばれることを目標にしてたなんて、今思うとすごく損してたなって思うけど」
　懐かしむように彼女は言った。
　とても昔。
　……とても遠い昔のことを思い出すように。
lines.label: s241
lines.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right; you don’t have to look like that. Even back then, you spent all your time with Arihiko and never seemed interested in any of your other classmates.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy.
My great ambition was to work up the courage to speak to you properly and hear you call me Yumizuka one day—looking back, I wasted so much time.”
She spoke wistfully.
A very long time ago.
As though remembering something from the impossibly distant past.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Now that I think about it, it was too small of a wish."

Those ancient days.
…… Like she is remembering something that happened a long time ago.

　けどこうして日が落ちて夜になったとたん、昨夜の出来事を鮮明に思い出してしまう。

lines.maoEnglish:
――――I didn’t know.
Until evening, I had been desperate to find Yumizuka.
But the instant the sun went down, the night before returned with terrible clarity.
The bodies strewn across the alley.
Yumizuka saying she had killed them.
Whatever her reasons, she had murdered all those people.
I knew the right choice was to stay out of it.

“Master Shiki, are you still awake…?”

“I’m awake—what is it, Hisui?”
“―――Yes, I hesitated because of the hour, but since you were awake, Master Shiki, I thought I ought to tell you.”

The question brought a silly old tale to mind.
Vampires could only move at night.

lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
No one else was in the park.
Nothing stirred beneath the moon.
For no reason I could name, the warmth drained from my body.
“―――Ngh.”
The back of my neck tingled.
A chill stole through me until my whole body fell deathly cold and even my fingertips began to numb.
“Hah, hah…”
While my body grew colder, my throat burned.
It was parched dry.
I slipped a hand into my pocket.
More than anything, I wanted a blade in my hand―――!

lines.maoEnglish:

My teeth ground together.
A faint headache.
My temperature falling.
My reason cooling into ice.
Something was wrong.
Something foul was churning through this park. It was all around me.
“What am I afraid of now?”
I shook off the headache and pressed deeper inside.

lines.mirrorMoon:

“I don’t really want to answer, but yes. I suppose I am.”
“What do you mean, ‘that’s what it means’—why?”
“It means what it means. I killed those people, and I’m sure I’ll keep doing the same thing. There’s no point lying about it, is there?”
lines.mirrorMoon:
"Then… the recent killings in town were all your doing, Yumizuka…!"
"I don't like to say it, but… that's the way it is, yeah."
"What the hell do you mean, 'That's the way it is' …!?"
"It's just the way it is.
I killed those people, and I'll keep on doing the same thing.
I can't just lie about it, can I?"

lines.japanese:
「弓……塚、おまえ―――」
「その呼び方、やめてくれないかな。
わたしだって志貴くんって呼んでるんだから、志貴くんも名前で呼んでくれないと不公平だよ」
「なっ――――」
　ごくりと息を飲む。
　弓塚はやっぱり以前のままだ。
　以前のままの仕草で―――ひどく恐ろしいことを、口にする。
lines.label: s242
lines.maoEnglish:
“Yumi―――zuka, you—”
“Would you stop calling me that? I call you Shiki, so it’s only fair that you call me Satsuki.”
“Wh――――”
I swallowed hard.
Yumizuka was still exactly as she had always been.
With all the same gestures as before―――she said something utterly horrifying.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yumi… zuka, you--"
"Please.
Stop calling me that.
I'm calling you Shiki-kun, so it's only fair for you to call me by my first name too."
"Wha…"
I take a deep breath.
Yumizuka is still like before.
Even though she acts like she used to----she says some pretty scary things.

lines.japanese:
「考えてみると、わたしってばかみたいだよね。
こんなふうに志貴くんって呼ぶこともできないで、何年間もあなたのことを遠くから見てるだけだった」
「弓―――塚？」
「ずっと志貴くんのことを見てた。
あの倉庫で助けられる前から、ずっと志貴くんの事を見てた。
　わたし、本当は臆病なんだ。
だから周りの人たちに合わせて、無理をして笑ったり話を合わせたりしてたらね、いつのまにかアイドルみたいに扱われちゃった」
lines.label: s242
lines.maoEnglish:
“When I think about it, I was such an idiot. For years I only watched you from afar, unable even to call you Shiki the way I do now.”
“Yumi―――zuka?”
“I was always watching you. Even before you rescued me from that warehouse, I had been watching you all along.
The truth is, I’m a coward. I kept forcing myself to smile and agree with everyone around me so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of idol.”

The truth is, I’m a coward. I kept forcing myself to smile and agree with everyone around me so I could fit in, and before I knew it, people were treating me like some kind of idol.”

lines.japanese:
「だから、学校はあんまり楽しくなかったんだ。
でも中学二年生になったばかりの時にね、志貴くんに話しかけられてから変わったんだ」
「え―――？」
「ううん、志貴くんは覚えてなんかないよ。
なんていうのかな、あなたはいつも自然で、飾らない人だから。
たぶんあの時の言葉も、志貴くんにとってなんでもない一言だったんだろうなあ」
「――――――」
　なんていえばいいんだろう。
　弓塚の言うとおり、俺は何も覚えていない。
　弓塚と何を話したのか、いや、弓塚と話したことがあるなんていうことさえ、覚えてない。
lines.label: s242
lines.maoEnglish:
“That was why I never enjoyed school much. But then, just after we started our second year of middle school, you spoke to me, and everything changed.”
“Huh―――?”
“No, you don’t remember. You’ve always been so natural, so completely yourself. Whatever you said that day was probably nothing at all to you.”
“――――――”
What could I possibly say?
She was right.
I remembered nothing—neither what we had spoken about nor even the fact that I had ever spoken to her.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"So school wasn't fun for me.
But that changed, after you talked to me in the second year of junior high, Shiki-kun."
"Eh--?"
"Nah.

Probably you didn't even think about what you said back then."

"------"

lines.japanese:
「いいよ、そんな顔しなくても。
志貴くんはあの頃から乾くんに付きっきりだったから、他のクラスメイトには興味がなさそうだったし」
「けど、それでも良かったんだ。
志貴くんと同じ教室にいるんだって思うだけで、すごく嬉しかった。
　いつかあなたにちゃんと話しかけて、弓塚さんって呼ばれることを目標にしてたなんて、今思うとすごく損してたなって思うけど」
　懐かしむように彼女は言った。
　とても昔。
　……とても遠い昔のことを思い出すように。
lines.label: s242
lines.maoEnglish:
“It’s all right; you don’t have to look like that. Even back then, you spent all your time with Arihiko and never seemed interested in any of your other classmates.”
“But I didn’t mind. Just knowing I was in the same classroom as you made me so happy.
My great ambition was to work up the courage to speak to you properly and hear you call me Yumizuka one day—looking back, I wasted so much time.”
She spoke wistfully.
A very long time ago.
As though remembering something from the impossibly distant past.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"It's okay.
Don't make a face like that.
You were only hanging out with Inui-kun, so it was normal for you to ignore other classmates."
"But that was okay.
I was happy just being in the same class as you, Shiki-kun.
It was my goal to talk to you and let you call me Yumizuka-san.
Now that I think about it, it was too small of a wish."
She recalls nostalgically.
Those ancient days.
…… like she is remembering something that happened a long time ago.

“I think I like you.”

　……弓塚は呆然と俺を見ている。
　それを、できるだけまっすぐに受け止めて、見つめ返す。
「―――――、だ」
　ふるふると首をふって。
　今にも泣き出しそうな顔で、彼女は言った。

lines.maoEnglish:
“――――――”
Yumizuka stared at me, stunned.
I met her gaze as directly as I could.
“―――――No.”
She shook her head.
On the verge of tears, she said it.
“―――I don’t want that.”
“Yumizuka…?”
“Because that would make me look like such an idiot―――”
Still dazed, Yumizuka lowered her head.

“――――――――――”
Without a word, Yumizuka slowly shook her head.

lines.japanese:
「どうして……！
　昔みたいに、普通に笑って、普通に歩いて、普通に話したりする事が、もうできないっていうのか。
たった―――たった二日前の話なのに……！」
「……そうだよね。
たった二日前まで、わたしも志貴くん側の生き物だったなんて、夢みたい。
失ってみて初めてわかった。
―――うん、ホントに夢みたいな時間だったなあ。
もし戻れるのなら、わたしはどんな代償を払っても戻りたい」
「なら―――」
「でも無理だよ。
わたしは元に戻れない。
ずっと、この寒くて痛くて、独りっきりのままで生きていくしかない」
　弓塚はうつむく。
　がくがくと震えていく、冷たい体。

「―――助けて、志貴くん」
　喉から搾り出すような、小さな声。

「恐いの。
すごく寒くて、どこにいってもわたしは独りきりで、すごく不安なの。
お願いだから、わたしを助けて」
　……わかってる。
　二日前の帰り道にした、なんでもない約束を、覚えている。
「―――ああ。
俺に出来る事なら、何でもするよ」
　……本当に。
　それで、きみがもとの弓塚さつきに戻れるっていうのなら、俺は何だってしてみせる。
　けれど。
　彼女の返答は、俺のそれとは、大きく違っていた。
lines.label: s312
lines.maoEnglish:
“Why…? Are you saying you can never smile normally again, or walk and talk like an ordinary person? It was only―――only two days ago…!”
“You’re right. It feels like a dream that only two days ago, I was still one of your kind. I never understood what I had until I lost it. ―――Yes, it truly was a dream. If I could go back, I would pay any price.”
“Then―――”
“But I can’t. I can never go back. I have to live forever in this cold and pain, all alone.”
Yumizuka lowered her head.
Her cold body trembled violently.
“―――Save me, Shiki.”
The tiny plea was wrung from her throat.
“I’m scared. I’m so cold, and wherever I go, I’m all alone and helpless. Please, save me.”
I understood.
I remembered the idle promise we had made on the way home two days ago.
“―――Yes. I’ll do anything I can.”
I meant it.
If that would restore the Satsuki Yumizuka she once was, I would do anything.
And yet…
Her answer was nothing like mine.

“But gradually I came to understand. It still stings a little, but soon even that will disappear. After all―――the sense of superiority that comes from taking a life feels many times better than the guilt of killing.
I told you, didn’t I? I’ll be just like you soon. Don’t worry. I’ll become a splendid vampire who enjoys killing people as much as you do.”
Yumizuka came closer, smiling.

“―――――That’s a lie.”
The moment I said it, I knew those words were a lie too.
Why utter a lie so poor it could not deceive even me?
――――No.
She was beyond saving.
Satsuki Yumizuka could no longer be saved.
Even the last of my reason surrendered to that hopeless conclusion.

Thank you. I’m sorry.
She had no reason to thank me. She had nothing to apologize for.
“I――killed you.”
Yet she thanked me all the same.
That was why.
I had truly wanted to save her.

　しびれた体が、かってに立ちあがる。
　今は、何も考えられない。
　心と体は別物なのか。
　ざっ、ざっ、と無様に体を引きずって、路地裏を後にした――――
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“―――――”
My numb body rose without my asking it to.
I could think of nothing.
Perhaps the heart and body really were separate things.
Dragging myself along with graceless, scraping steps, I left the alley behind――――

Mindlessly dragging my body, I exit the alley----

ぎい、と音をたてて扉が開く。
　傷だらけの体をひきずって、ようやく屋敷に帰ってきた。
「――――――あ」
　ロビーには秋葉がいた。
　あれからずっとここで待っていたんだろうか。
　……今の自分には、もう、何もわからない。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
The door creaked open.
Dragging myself along despite my wounds, I finally made it back to the mansion.
“――――――Ah.”
Akiha was in the foyer.
Had she been waiting there all this time?
I could no longer understand anything.

lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Where have you been, Brother? Do you have any idea what time it―――”
“B-Brother, your body―――”
Akiha was shocked.
Why?
I no longer wanted to think about what had startled her.

「――――――」
　秋葉は無言で息を飲むと、つかつかとこちらに近づいてきた。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother, stay with me…! What happened to leave you covered in wounds and looking so awful?”
“……”
I gave no answer. No—I couldn’t.
I couldn’t even understand what Akiha was saying.
“――――――”
Akiha caught her breath, then strode straight toward me.
lines.mao_english:

I couldn’t even understand what Akiha was saying.
“――――――”
Akiha caught her breath, then strode straight toward me.
lines.mirrorMoon:

"------"
Akiha gasps silently and then walks towards me.

lines.japanese:
「とにかく手当てをしないと。
兄さん、歩けますか？」
「………………」
　ああ。
生きているんだから、歩くことぐらいはできる。
「手当てをしますから居間に来てください。
あ、それとお風呂――は無理ですから、お湯で体を拭かないといけませんね」
　秋葉はパタパタと足音をたてて消えていった。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“We have to tend to your wounds. Can you walk, Brother?”
“……”
Yes. I was still alive, so surely I could manage that much.
“Come to the sitting room so I can treat you. And a bath――no, that’s impossible, so I’ll have to wipe you down with hot towels.”
Akiha hurried away, her footsteps pattering into the distance.

lines.japanese:
―――秋葉は一人で俺の怪我の手当てをしてくれた。
　汚れた体もタオルで拭いて、食べ物まで作ってくれたあげく、部屋まで連れてきてくれた。
　その間、俺は一言も、口にすることなんか、できなかった。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
―――Akiha tended every one of my wounds herself.
She wiped the filth from my body, cooked something for me, and finally brought me to my room.
Through all of it, I could not utter a single word.
lines.mao_english:
―――Akiha tended every one of my wounds herself.
She wiped the filth from my body, cooked something for me, and finally brought me to my room.
Through all of it, I could not utter a single word.
lines.mirrorMoon:

「……それでは、私は戻ります。
兄さんも今夜はゆっくり眠ってください」
　何も聞かず。
　秋葉は最後まで何も聞かず、静かに立ち去っていこうとする。
　消えていく。
　俺が、殺してしまった、彼女の、ように。
――――そう思った瞬間、秋葉の腕を掴んでしまった。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’ll leave you now. Please get a good night’s sleep, Brother.”
She had asked nothing.
Still asking nothing, Akiha quietly turned to leave.
She was disappearing.
Just like the girl I had killed.
――――The moment I thought that, my hand seized Akiha’s arm.

lines.mirrorMoon:

lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Brother――!?”
I pulled her into my arms and held her tight.
I could not bear to be alone.
I needed to feel another person’s warmth.
lines.mao_english:

lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“Aki―――ha.”
I clung to her without thought.
Akiha said nothing.
Ordinarily she would have pushed me away at once, yet now she did not pull away from me as I trembled.
If only we could stay this way―――simply remain as we were.

lines.japanese:
「俺は、最低だ」
　そう、告白して。
　自分の罪から、秋葉に逃げた。
「……助けたかった……助けたかったのに、助けてやる事が、できなかった」
　ぐっ、と救いを求めるように秋葉を抱きしめる。
　秋葉からの答えはない。
　まるで俺の弱さを嫌うように、秋葉は俺から体を離した。
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“I’m the worst.”
That was my confession.
I fled from my guilt into Akiha’s arms.
“I wanted to save her, but I couldn’t.”
I tightened my embrace as though begging Akiha to save me instead.
Akiha gave no answer.
As though disgusted by my weakness, she drew herself away.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
"I, am the worst."
I confess.
From my sin, and I escape to Akiha.
"…… I wanted to save her…… I wanted to save her…… but I couldn't do anything."
As if seeking salvation, I squeeze Akiha tighter.
There's no response from Akiha.
As if repelled by my weakness, Akiha pulls away.

「私には何も答えてあげることはできません。
兄さんの問題は兄さんが解決すべきことです。
　ですから―――こんなことで、私に甘えないでください」
lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“…Brother, I don’t know what happened to you. I’m sure it isn’t something I should ask about.”
“――――”
“And there is no answer I can give you. Your problem is one you must resolve yourself.
So please―――don’t come seeking comfort from me over something like this.”

lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:

Her rebuke was so painfully accurate that at last I regained control of myself.

“……”

She was about to leave when she came to an abrupt stop.

lines.label: s312a
lines.maoEnglish:
“――――I won’t ask what happened.
But when I watched you leave earlier, Brother, I was terrified. I had the strangest feeling that you would never come back. It was the same dread I felt eight years ago.”
“―――――――”
“But you did come back.
You said there was someone you couldn’t save. Yet at least you saved me from that dreadful premonition.”

「私からはそれだけです。

My right arm hangs heavy with the knife; my limp left arm burns.
The heat comes from flowing blood.
Yumizuka’s claws have ripped through cloth and skin and opened my arm.
Perhaps that bleeding cooled the blood boiling inside me.
My heart’s violent pounding begins to subside.
But when awareness returns.
I find myself embracing Yumizuka, my knife buried through her heart.

　またもやデッドエンドを迎えてしまった遠野くんの為のこのコーナー、
“教えて！
知得留先生！
”の時間がやってきちゃいました。
lines.label: s533

who has managed to hit yet another dead end.

lines.japanese:
三日目の二時間目は家族愛についてです。
　今回遠野くんがデッドしてしまった理由は簡単。
　弓塚さんに噛まれてしまった時、それを跳ね除ける力の要因となってくれる事柄が希薄だったコトでしょう。
lines.label: s533
lines.maoEnglish:
Lesson two of day three concerns familial love.
The reason Tohno died this time is simple. When Yumizuka bit him, the feelings that might have given him the strength to throw her off were too weak.
lines.mao_english:

lines.mirrorMoon:
The second period lesson of the third day will be about filial love.
The reason you died this time is simple, Tohno-kun.
There wasn't enough incentive in you to pull Yumizuka-san off of you the instant she bit you.

mirrorMoonErrors.reason: 家族愛 is family or familial love, while 'filial love' specifically means a child's love or duty toward a parent. The lesson applies its category to Shiki's bond with Akiha and then discusses sibling and classmate attachments, so the narrow English term names the wrong relationship class. This system-facing explanation should be promoted as a material terminology error.
mirrorMoonErrors.title: Family love becomes filial love

lines.japanese:
家族の絆は大切に。
　クラスメイトも大事です。
　遠野くんはもっとお兄ちゃんとして妹さんを気にかけてあげないといけないし、クラスメイトだった子の思いにもなんらかの応えを出してあげないと。
　はい、なにしろ二人とも年期入ってますからね～。
lines.label: s533
lines.maoEnglish:
Treasure the bonds of family.
Your classmates matter too.
Tohno needs to pay more attention to his little sister as her older brother, and he owes some kind of answer to the feelings of the girl who used to be his classmate. After all, both girls have been carrying those feelings for a very long time.
lines.mao_english:

Your classmates matter too.
Tohno needs to pay more attention to his little sister as her older brother, and he owes some kind of answer to the feelings of the girl who used to be his classmate. After all, both girls have been carrying those feelings for a very long time.
lines.mirrorMoon:
Bonds of family are very important.
Classmates are also important.
You have to make sure you concern yourself with being a good Onii-chan, and you have to somehow answer your classmate's love.
Yes, you have obligations to both of them.

lines.japanese:
それではちょっしたアドバイス。
　ここにきてしまった遠野くんは少し前に戻って、ちゃんと弓塚さんへの誠心誠意を見せてみるといいかもしれません。
　それでは皆さん、また次の授業で会いましょー。
lines.label: s533
lines.maoEnglish:
Here is a little advice.
If you ended up here, go back a short way and show Yumizuka that you sincerely care.
That’s all, everyone—I’ll see you at the next lesson.

lines.mirrorMoon:

Tohno-kun, it's probably good if you go back and show Yumizuka-san some sincerity.
Well then, let's meet again in the next lesson, everyone.
